name: National Museum of African American History and Culture
tagline: The Smithsonian's African American history museum. Plan a full visit.
description: The newest Smithsonian on the Mall (opened 2016), in a David Adjaye corona-shaped building. The lower-level history galleries are the headline; the cultural galleries upstairs cover music, sports, and art. Plan to enter at the bottom and work up.
review_long:
The architecture is intentional: visitors descend three levels into the History Galleries and then ascend back to the cultural galleries above. The history portion — slavery, Reconstruction, Jim Crow, civil rights — takes most visitors 2–3 hours by itself.

Timed entry passes are still required and the most popular times release at 8:15 AM thirty days ahead. Same-day passes appear at 8:15 AM the day-of and disappear within minutes.

tips.text: Timed passes book a month out. Same-day passes drop at 8:15 AM.

distance_landmark: On the National Mall, near the Washington Monument
